name: compute-ledger
title: Compute Ledger: public records of the physical, social and economic footprint of AI compute
description: Every table the ledger publishes, with its columns. Paths are relative to this file. `pipeline/build_data_package.py` checks every table against this schema on every build (CI fails on a mismatch) and writes the readable version, data/DICTIONARY.md. Controlled values for metric, unit, basis and relation are in pipeline/measurement_vocab.json.

licenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
licenses.title: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (data); see README for the rows that cite Wikipedia

resources.name: measurements
resources.description: Every figure in the ledger, one row each: permits, metered loads, filed demand, company statements, computed values. Start here.

fields.name: measurement_id
fields.description: Content hash of feed, subject, metric, metric_detail, period, value_as_published, source_url, side and entry_id. It changes when any of those change (a corrected figure gets a new id); see CHANGELOG.md.

fields.name: subject_type
fields.description: What the figure is about: a site (site_register), an entity such as a utility (entity_register), or a ledger entry as a whole (entries).

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: The site_id, entity_id or entry id.

fields.name: entry_id
fields.description: The ledger entry the figure belongs to, if any.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: What is measured, from pipeline/measurement_vocab.json (e.g. electricity_consumed, permitted_standby_generation).

fields.name: metric_detail
fields.description: What exactly the figure counts, in words: scope, fuel, building, part of the site.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The figure in its published unit (the low end for a range).

fields.name: value_high
fields.description: The high end of a range, if the source gives one.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: The published unit, from the vocabulary (e.g. GJ, MW, short_ton, m3).

fields.name: value_canonical
fields.description: The value converted to one unit per dimension (MWh, MW, MWth, t, m3, m3/day, ha, h). Empty where the unit has no fixed conversion.

fields.name: value_high_canonical
fields.description: value_high converted the same way.

fields.name: canonical_unit
fields.description: The unit of value_canonical.

fields.name: value_as_published
fields.description: The figure exactly as written in the text it was taken from: the document's line or cell, or for registry figures the entry's own sentence.

fields.name: qualifier
fields.description: Read from the words around the figure ('about', 'at least', 'up to').

fields.name: period_start
fields.description: First day the figure covers (ISO date). Empty if the source gives no period.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: Last day the figure covers.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: What kind of document the figure rests on (metered, permitted, filed, company_statement, press_report, derived...).

fields.name: side
fields.description: record: a regulator, court, grid operator, utility, statistics office, auditor, registry or government decision. claim: what a company, applicant or government says or plans.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Link to the document.

fields.name: source_title
fields.description: Title of the document, with page or table where known.

fields.name: source_publisher
fields.description: Who published it.

fields.name: source_date
fields.description: Date of the document as known (ISO date, year-month or year). Empty if not known.

fields.name: feed
fields.description: The file in this repository the row was built from. To correct a figure, edit that file and run ./rebuild.sh.

fields.name: extraction
fields.description: How the figure was taken from its source.

fields.name: second_read
fields.description: yes if a second reading, by a different method or person, confirmed it against the document.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: What a reader needs to know to use the figure: caveats, conversions, part years.

resources.name: measurement_id_aliases
resources.description: Figures whose id changed because their wording or value was corrected: the retired id, the id that replaced it, when and why. A citation of a retired id resolves here.

fields.name: retired_measurement_id
fields.description: The id no longer in measurements.csv.

fields.name: measurement_id
fields.description: The id of the corrected figure in measurements.csv.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the correction.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: What was corrected.

resources.name: site_register
resources.description: Every site the ledger has figures or links for: datacenters, buildings that file as datacenters, crypto mining sites, nuclear plants, chip fabs, smelters and refiners. One page each on the website.

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: Stable id. Retired ids are mapped in site_id_aliases.csv.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name as the register or document gives it.

fields.name: operator
fields.description: Operator or permittee, where known.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What the site is.

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

fields.name: admin_region
fields.description: State, province or county.

fields.name: locality
fields.description: Town or address.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees. Empty if the site is not yet placed.

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Usually operating, permitted, under_construction, announced or refused; Texas rows carry the TCEQ project status as text.

fields.name: ct_source_id
fields.description: Climate TRACE asset id, where the site was matched to one.

fields.name: backlog_id
fields.description: Id in the unlocated-site backlog, if the site came from it.

fields.name: register_source
fields.description: The register or document the site was taken from.

fields.name: also_known_as
fields.description: Other names and ids (registration numbers, licence numbers).

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Caveats.

resources.name: site_id_aliases
resources.description: Site ids that were retired (merged duplicates) and the id that replaced each.

fields.name: retired_site_id
fields.description: The id no longer used.

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: The id that replaced it (in site_register.csv).

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why it was retired.

resources.name: entity_register
resources.description: Companies, utilities and registers that figures or chain links refer to.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: Stable id.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Company, municipal utility, cooperative, register...

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Caveats.

resources.name: entries
resources.description: The ledger's entries as a flat table, built from registry/*.json: the record, the claim and the one-line gap between them.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Entry id (stable).

fields.name: registry_file
fields.description: The registry file the entry lives in; edit it there.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country or countries, as names; 'EU' and 'Global' for entries above country level.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Region within the country.

fields.name: site_or_subject
fields.description: What the entry is about.

fields.name: operator
fields.description: Operator or responsible party.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude of the site or area (approximate for areas).

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Theme of the entry.

fields.name: record
fields.description: What the public record says, with numbers and dates.

fields.name: claim
fields.description: What the operator or government says in public, or 'none found'.

fields.name: gap
fields.description: The difference between record and claim, in one line, without adjectives.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: How firmly the record rests on record holders' documents that were read.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.description: Result of the second reading of the record against its documents.

fields.name: verification_note
fields.description: What was read, when, and what was found.

fields.name: last_checked
fields.description: Date the entry was last checked.

fields.name: receipt
fields.description: Id of the worked case in receipts/, if the entry has one.

fields.name: n_record_sources
fields.description: Number of record sources (listed in entry_sources.csv).

fields.name: n_claim_sources
fields.description: Number of claim sources.

resources.name: entry_sources
resources.description: Every document an entry cites, one row each, with the side it supports.

fields.name: entry_id
fields.description: Entry id.

fields.name: side
fields.description: Whether the document supports the record or the claim.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title, with page or section where given.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Link.

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Publisher.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date as known.

fields.name: date_note
fields.description: Why the date is uncertain, where it is.

resources.name: edges
resources.description: Documented links in the chain from smelter to chipmaker to site and its power, fuel and water. Column guide: sites/chain/README.md.

fields.name: edge_id
fields.description: Content hash of the row (notes and second_read excluded).

fields.name: leg
fields.description: Which leg of the chain (refiner_to_maker, power_to_site, water_to_site...).

fields.name: from_type
fields.description: site, entity, entry, or named (a party not yet in a register).

fields.name: from_id
fields.description: Id of the supplying party.

fields.name: from_name
fields.description: Its name as the document gives it.

fields.name: relation
fields.description: From the vocabulary: refines_for, supplies_power_to, supplies_water_to...

fields.name: to_type
fields.description: As from_type.

fields.name: to_id
fields.description: Id of the receiving party.

fields.name: to_name
fields.description: Its name as the document gives it.

fields.name: period_start
fields.description: When the link held, if the document says.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: End of that period.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Kind of document; company_statement makes the edge a claim.

fields.name: side
fields.description: record or claim.

fields.name: document_title
fields.description: Document that states the link.

fields.name: document_url
fields.description: Link.

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Publisher.

fields.name: document_date
fields.description: Date of the document.

fields.name: quoted_line
fields.description: The phrase in the document that states the link, copied exactly.

fields.name: entry_id
fields.description: The ledger entry that discusses it.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: What the reader needs to know.

fields.name: second_read
fields.description: yes or no, with how it was confirmed.

resources.name: checks
resources.description: Every check run on the ledger: what was checked, how, by whom, and what it found. Built from review/CHECKS.csv and the findings files.

fields.name: check_id
fields.description: Id.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the check.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Short name.

fields.name: what_was_checked
fields.description: Scope.

fields.name: method
fields.description: How.

fields.name: checker
fields.description: Who (always someone other than the person who did the work).

fields.name: selection
fields.description: How the items were chosen (all, random sample, targeted).

fields.name: n_checked
fields.description: How many items.

fields.name: result
fields.description: What it found.

fields.name: findings_file
fields.description: The file in review/ with the findings.

fields.name: applied_in
fields.description: Where the corrections were applied.

fields.name: n_findings_in_table
fields.description: Findings from this check in findings.csv.

fields.name: findings_by_severity
fields.description: Counts by severity.

fields.name: status_now
fields.description: What the current data show for those findings, recomputed at every build.

resources.name: findings
resources.description: Every finding from every check, with what the data show now.

fields.name: finding_id
fields.description: Id.

fields.name: check_id
fields.description: The check (checks.csv).

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the check.

fields.name: subject_type
fields.description: figure, link, entry, text or other.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: What it concerns.

fields.name: entry_id
fields.description: Entry, if any.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Where in the file or entry.

fields.name: quoted
fields.description: The text or value as it stood when checked.

fields.name: finding
fields.description: What the checker found.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: As the checker gave it.

fields.name: status_now
fields.description: What the current data show, recomputed at every build.
